findings.issue: The claim-or-descriptive status of each T-E endpoint is left to a later deviations entry written after the split freeze. That entry would be written with the realised counts in hand, which leaves room to move a threshold or an endpoint.
findings.evidence: Amendment l.323-324: 'The final counts and the claim/descriptive status of each T-E endpoint are fixed in a stamped entry of the deviations file after the split freeze and before any EA number.' points.recommendation: Adopt the PROPOSED eligible-only rule of hydromet_ea_protocol.md §4 with S = 0.50, the > 15 % guard kept, plus an all-station status table (finding EA-INELIGIBLE-STATIONS) and pinned inputs. Options (a)-(c) of Q4 refer to the withdrawn rule and are not needed.
points.reason: The rule is label-free and I reproduced every count from metadata. At S = 0.50 the test cell has 141 test-capable stations in 21 groups, G_eff 11.2 (DO 123 in 21, G_eff 12.1); at S = 0.40 it has 117 in 19, G_eff 9.2 (DO 99, G_eff 10.2). The minimum is G >= 15 and G_eff >= 8, and realised counts can only fall after QC. The primary zero-shot claim uses no England training row, so the cost falls on fine-tuning only (381 train-role stations instead of 470; 27 non-test groups left for M1's draw instead of 30). No cross-role flow pair exists at either S.

points.recommendation: Confirm, and make the loader enforce it: order is M6 split freeze, then M1's sonde_ea_split.json, then the first M6 England fit.
points.reason: ea_data.load_ea has no M1-test filter today, and M1 can draw only after M6's freeze (ea_england_allocation.md l.56-60). A fit before the draw could train on groups M1 later takes as test.

points.recommendation: Decide now, in or out. If in: roles from COMID and metadata before any value is read, pushdown filters, licence rows for gridMET and StreamCat, peak transient size counted against the 20 GB cap, and the tables pinned before the first post-stamp fit. No Tier 2 addition later in this round.
points.reason: Tier 2 stations are outside the track-N set, so only the lever role rules protect them, and those need a COMID first. Adding the tier after inner-criterion numbers exist would be a pool choice made after results. Disk is not a limit (179 GB free).

The stricter option; the heatwave endpoints are claim endpoints by the lead ruling, so they belong in the family.

points.reason: An open variant rule is a way to add configurations after results. The data side is safe only if every variant reads the same pinned tables.

summary: Hash matches. No blocking finding; 12 should_fix, 5 notes. No arch-v2 or England validation number exists (registry: 97 rows, the last two are train-only smoke starts). Main risks: the England split exists only as proposed text while the build code would freeze the withdrawn, label-count-based rule; 864 ineligible stations get no status, 366-409 of them flow-connected to test-role stations; the England loader does not exclude M1-test groups; the hourly build loaded rows dated on or after 2023-10-01 at 366 train-role sites (nothing stored); pin and stamp gates are self-certified; licence rows are missing. Recommend the eligible-only rule with S = 0.50, an all-station status table, and T-E stamped by reference only.
